sources.who: Dana Lee — Running out of flour

problems.text: We run out of flour before we notice

quotes.text: Last month we ran out twice on a Saturday and had to close the cake counter by noon.

problems.text: We lose track of an order once its paper ticket is gone

quotes.text: When a ticket gets lost the customer calls us and we have no idea where the cake is.

scope.covered: Order tracking from the WhatsApp order to the courier handoff, and flour stock.

systems.name: Orders
systems.purpose: Tracks each order from WhatsApp to the courier handoff; closes P2

features.name: Order board
features.does: Shows every order and its stage, so staff answer a customer's call without searching paper tickets

systems.name: Stock
systems.purpose: Keeps flour on hand for weekend baking; closes P1

features.name: Low-flour alert
features.does: Warns the owner when flour drops below a set level, before a Saturday runs out

assumptions.text: Orders keep arriving by WhatsApp; staff copy each one onto the board

questions.text: Last time you ran out of flour, how much was left the day before?
